desc:
Welcome to Pixél Brainrot!— where creativity meets competition!

Collect, train, and battle over 500 unique Brainrots in this colorful creature-battling adventure. Build your strongest team, challenge other players, or just chill and explore a world full of surprises and rare finds.

🎨 What You Can Do:
• Catch and collect over 500+ Brainrots 🧩
• Train your team and take on epic battles ⚔️
• Trade with friends and build your dream lineup 🤝
• Play solo or join multiplayer battles 🌍
• Enjoy regular events and updates! 🌟

Can you collect them all and become the Ultimate Brainrot Master?
Have tons of fun!

EVOS WAVE 2 ARE HERE!🎉🥳
Find them out for yourself

NOTES:
Most of the images used in this game are not mine, so thanks to the people who made them! I don't think this game abuses the Roblox game rules, but if they do, Roblox just tell me and i will take it down.
